title: Norda acquires Sudo
text: On 31 December N-1, Norda acquired 100% of the shares of Sudo for 12,000, paid in cash on that date. The individual balance sheets just before the acquisition are given below.

Sudo has developed a brand internally, never recognised in its own balance sheet; its fair value is estimated at 2,300 on 31 December N-1. The brand has an indefinite useful life and is not impaired in N. All other book values equal fair values.

title: Company Halvor – acquisition of a machine
text: Halvor recently acquired a new machine:
– The machine is received on 1 April N and ready for use on 1 July N.
– Purchase price: 1,800,000, paid 60 days after delivery.
– Customs duties: 45,000. Transport insurance: 15,000. Transport cost: 40,000.
– Training of the users by the machine's manufacturer: 25,000.
– Useful life: 8 years. The machine will be sold at the end of its useful life; its residual value is estimated at 260,000.

title: Medora – new drug project
text: Medora, a pharmaceutical company, starts a project in year N to develop a new drug. It spends 1,400,000 on the project during N, and a further 600,000 from January to October N+1.

On 1 November N+1 Medora receives the authorisation of the national health authority to sell the drug. In November and December N+1 it spends 120,000 on an advertising campaign. Sales start in January N+2.
